title: Wemyss Malts announces return of Velvet Fig | Whisky Magazine
description: Coveted whisky's re-release forms part of Wemyss Malts' 15th anniversary celebrations
text: Wemyss Malts has announced the return of a coveted whisky as part of its 15th anniversary celebrations. Velvet Fig, which was first released in 2014 to rave reviews, has returned in the form of a 25-year-old sherry cask blended malt composed with Highlands, Speyside and Islay whiskies. At the time of its release, Velvet Fig was Wemyss Malts' first limited-edition blended malt. It went on to win Best Scotch Blended Malt at the World Whiskies Awards in 2015. While the original expression is now finished, the reverence in which it is held by some whisky fans convinced Wemyss Malts to find a way of bringing it back.

title: Heaven Hill Springs Distillery opens - Drinks International
description: The new Bardstown distillery joins Heaven Hill's Bernheim facility in Louisville.
text: The $200m distillery began production in April 2025 and joins Heaven Hill’s existing Bernheim facility in Louisville, expanding the company’s Bourbon production footprint. “As an independent, family-owned company, we’ve always had the freedom to take the long view. Heaven Hill Springs Distillery is a long-term, generational investment in our brands, our people, and our place in Kentucky. It’s designed not just for today’s whiskey, but for the future of American Whiskey,” said Kate Latts, co-president of Heaven Hill Brands. The opening marked Heaven Hill’s return to Bardstown since 1996, as the facility began operation with an initial capacity of 150,000 barrels per year, with future scalability to 450,000 barrels.

title: Lagavulin distillery - Wikipedia
description: Encyclopedia entry on Lagavulin distillery on Islay, its owners and its whisky.
text:
Lagavulin distillery is an Islay single malt Scotch whisky distillery in the village of Lagavulin, on the south of the island of Islay, Scotland. Owner: Diageo. Founded: 1816. Capacity: 1,400,000 L.

History
The distillery of Lagavulin officially dates from 1816, when John Johnston and Archibald Campbell Brooks built two distilleries on the site. One of them became Lagavulin and took over the other; which one is not exactly known.

title: Glann ar Mor distillery - Wikipedia
description: French whisky distillery in Pleubian, Brittany.
text: Glann ar Mor distillery is a French whisky distillery located in Pleubian, Côtes-d'Armor, Brittany. Glann ar Mor was created in 1997 by Celtic Whisky Compagnie, with the first single malt whisky produced in December 1999. In its present form, Glann ar Mor has been operational since June 2005, bottling its first unpeated single malt in late 2008.
